==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am inside of a school for witches and wizards. The school resembles a massive black castle. It is located on a distant, mountainous, island.

I am a woman with long, silver, dreadlocks. I am a student at the school. I feel as if I am inside of someone else's fan fiction.

I sit next to the most skilled wizard at the school at a banquet. The wizard is suddenly choked by the spell of a demonic spirit. I don't have any way of defending him, so I just make jokes about the situation while hoping he can save himself.
